title: An Intelligent Method for Predicting Pacific Oyster ( Crassostrea gigas ) Freshness Using Deep Learning Fused with Malondialdehyde and Total Sulfhydryl Groups Information.
summary: Primary Methods and Results support a bounded food-quality application; validation is limited to the reported samples and conditions.
ai_technology: AlexNet-based image classifiers estimate MDA/SH levels; a fitted relationship maps those classes to oyster storage day.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Original Results link image classifications to measured chemistry and storage-day estimates for refrigerated oyster samples.
evidence.unknown: Biochemical measurements across eight storage batches support the fitted relationship; no independent external cohort is reported.
